skills.name: make-an-app
skills.description: How Juli makes an app from a skeleton: choose the one that fits, fill its slots with the person's own content, and say plainly what it can't do.

skills.name: change-an-app
skills.description: How Juli changes an app the person already made: a setting (slot) first, a small added part only when no slot can do it, one small step at a time, with Undo.

skills.name: play-four-in-a-row
skills.description: How Juli picks a strong Four in a Row move from the columns the game offers: win now, block the person, follow the game's read, build from the middle.

skills.name: make-a-game
skills.description: How a game for p0pc0rn is made: Juli fills a game design's slots; a new game (chess, checkers, cards) needs its own design, written on the Game Kit.

skills.name: watch-a-wallet
skills.description: How Juli reads public Avalanche activity for Wallet Watch: say plainly what changed, describe a wallet's habits from its numbers, never advise and never guess who is behind an address.
